newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume eases.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume eases.

text.p: Traded volume on Istanbul's gold exchange fell to 925 kilos on Friday from Thursday's two-month high of 1,434 kilos as demand eased after hectic trade earlier in the week, dealers said.
The market closed for a 1-1/2 day official holiday to Wednesday when volume jumped to 1,025 kilos from 235 kilos on Monday morning.

Dealers said lower prices in international gold markets had fuelled buying by free-market exchange shops and banks in the last two days, but traders were now taking a wait-and-see line on Friday as world prices continued to ease.

Gold closed at $377.60 an ounce, down sharply from Thursday's $380.10. But it rose to 1,178,700 lira per gram from yesterday's 1,175,600 due to a weaker lira which closed at 96,430 against the dollar versus previous 96,150.
Volume was 470 kilos in the first session and 455 in the afternoon. 72 percent of the total trade was in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 08 75 ATA EKS
